title: notes-to-self-daily-2026-03-04
content:
Daily scratchpad - Noah W. (quick, messy)
Date: 2026-03-04

Morning priorities:
- Finish perf regression triage for RD-3421 (KV cache edge-case). Need to reproduce with seq_len=1024 workload. Check Avery's repro script in /tmp/repro_kv.sh.
- Merge small hotfix for batching timeout (PR #987) after unit tests pass - circle CI flake sometimes on cpu-mem test. If flakey, rerun only that step.
- Prep notes for 11:00 sync with SRE about autoscale cooldown tuning (bring recent 95th latency numbers).

Quick TODOs (short):
- Ping Maya about canary rollout thresholds (Slack: @maya, message draft ready).
- Add two prompts to eval set: `prompt-kv-edge-1` and `prompt-kv-edge-2` - record expected outputs.
- Remove old experiment cluster (exp-2024-q4) from inventory - ask infra for deprovision window.

Meeting notes / follow-ups:
- 10:00 standup: remind team about de-prioritizing new quantization proposal until after dedicated benchmark.
- 11:00 SRE sync: confirm we want target_spare_capacity=0.15 and cooldown=120s for dedicated pools. Action: SRE to run a 2-hour soak on staging.
- 14:00 Design review w/ Console team: show cost-breakdown mockups, ask for per-route grouping option. Action: share Figma link and short one-pager.

Bugs / unknowns to investigate:
- Why memory use spikes after 250k tokens on long-session test (session-id: sess-7f3a). Hypothesis: delayed KV release on fallback path.
- Intermittent 503s when routing to variant-small during burst; might be backpressure config.

Personal / errands (non-work):
- Dentists appointment rescheduled to 2026-03-10 at 16:30 - update calendar.
- Pick up prescription after standup (pharmacy closes 18:00).
- Grocery: milk, eggs, spinach, coffee pods.

Notes to self (random):
- If repro script fails locally, try reproducing on staging with reduced concurrency first.
- When writing rollout doc, include rollback criteria + latency regression threshold (+10% P95).
- Save a snapshot of current perf dashboards before running experiments (Console > Dashboards > Serving > Last 7d).

Quick links I might need:
- KV cache idea page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/123456789/kv-cache-ideas
- RD-3421 ticket
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987

End of scratchpad. Will polish into a proper doc if any of the follow-ups require a public writeup.
